title: ImplicitHop: Evaluating knowledge integration across context and memory
abstract: arXiv:2610.41169v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The ability to integrate new information and deduce its consequences is central to learning, understanding, and reasoning in large language models (LLMs). Whether information arrives during training or in-context, models must not only store local facts, but propagate their long-range implications globally. To explore information integration in LLMs, we introduce two complementary natural language benchmarks for large-scale evaluation of deductive reasoning as a function of inference depth. The first is a formal graph benchmark enabling controlled evaluation over a wide range of graph topologies and integration tasks; the second is a knowledge composition benchmark grounded in real-world knowledge graphs. We use these benchmarks to compare knowledge integration from information encoded in context versus information encoded in model weights during pretraining, evaluating a set of open models implicitly, without chain of thought. translated_title: ImplicitHop：评估跨上下文与记忆的知识整合
translated_abstract: 整合新信息并推导其结论的能力是大型语言模型（LLM）中学习、理解与推理的核心。无论信息是在训练期间提供还是在上下文中给出，模型不仅要存储局部事实，还必须将其长程影响全局传播。为探索LLM中的信息整合，我们引入了两个互补的自然语言基准，用于大规模评估演绎推理能力随推理深度的变化。第一个是形式化图基准，可在广泛的图拓扑结构和整合任务上进行受控评估；第二个是基于真实世界知识图谱的知识组合基准。我们利用这些基准来比较从上下文编码的信息与预训练期间编码在模型权重中的信息之间的知识整合能力，并在不使用思维链的情况下对一组开源模型进行隐式评估。我们发现……
tldr: 本文提出ImplicitHop基准，通过形式化图基准和基于真实知识图谱的组合基准两个互补数据集，评估开源LLM在不使用思维链的情况下，从上下文与预训练权重中隐式整合知识和进行演绎推理的能力如何随推理深度变化。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces ImplicitHop, two complementary benchmarks—a formal graph benchmark and a real-world knowledge-graph composition benchmark—to evaluate how open LLMs implicitly integrate knowledge and perform deductive reasoning, without chain-of-thought, from both in-context information and pretrained weights across varying inference depths.
